digest.component_or_area: Claude Code agent configuration / Serena MCP integration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction compared to always-loaded tools like Bash
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only deferral control exposed by Claude Code and operates globally (all-or-nothing) rather than per-tool or per-server

A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false will make Serena tools resident at session start at a measured cost of ~25k additional tokens (Serena-only baseline) to ~64k tokens (with 4 MCP servers)
The original acceptance criterion to limit always-loaded tools to <=4 named Serena navigation tools is not implementable due to the global-only nature of the ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH lever
.claude/settings.json must be individually un-ignored in .gitignore while keeping .claude/ directory itself ignored, and the change is revertible by deleting one JSON key
